text: Ivan Ilyichs life had been most simple and most ordinary. <break time="0.8s" /> And for that very reason. <break time="0.8s" /> As the rest of the story slowly and painfully reveals. <break time="0.8s" /> It had also been most terrible. <break time="0.8s" /> The son of an official. <break time="0.8s" /> He studied law. <break time="0.8s" /> Took up a modest post in the provinces. <break time="0.8s" /> And quickly learned. <break time="0.8s" /> To do whatever was considered proper. <break time="0.8s" /> By the people of high rank around him. <break time="0.8s" /> Like a fly drawn toward the light. <break time="0.8s" /> He was drawn toward those. <break time="0.8s" /> Who stood above him. <break time="0.8s" /> Adopting their manners and their views. <break time="0.8s" /> Without ever asking. <break time="0.8s" /> Whether they were truly right. <break time="0.8s" /> He married Praskovya Fyodorovna. <break time="0.8s" /> A pretty girl of good family. <break time="0.8s" /> Not so much because he loved her deeply. <break time="0.8s" /> As because the marriage was pleasant to him. <break time="0.8s" /> And was approved by the right people. <break time="0.8s" /> When his wife grew jealous and demanding. <break time="0.8s" /> During her first pregnancy. <break time="0.8s" /> He did not try to understand her. <break time="0.8s" /> But withdrew, little by little. <break time="0.8s" /> Into his work. <break time="0.8s" /> Where everything was orderly. <break time="0.8s" /> And under his control. <break time="0.8s" /> In court. <break time="0.8s" /> He learned to strip away. <break time="0.8s" /> Everything human from a case. <break time="0.8s" /> Reducing living people. <break time="0.8s" /> To documents and forms. <break time="0.8s" /> So that he could deal with them coolly. <break time="0.8s" /> While still appearing polite and fair. <break time="0.8s" /> Thus his years passed. <break time="0.8s" /> Lightly, pleasantly, and decently. <break time="0.8s" /> Filled with official duties. <break time="0.8s" /> Comfortable dinners. <break time="0.8s" /> And evening games of cards. <break time="0.8s" /> And it never occurred to him. <break time="0.8s" /> That anything essential might be missing.
